title: 第一卷 第11章 季大伯：呜呜呜
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

军人服务社相当于部队内部的小商店和生活补给站，外部人员进不来。

里面的东西比外面供销社的便宜，而且像手电筒，电池这样的，外面需要特定的票，在这里则是随便买。

当然，如果想买什么紧俏稀缺的商品这里也可以代买，算是给军人的一种福利。

可是她怎么才能得到这个工作呢！

就在季望棉纠结的时候，门口有脚步声，季望棉坏心眼的笑了笑，起身。

开门，出门就撞到了一个温热湿润的怀抱。

“哎呀！”

季望棉身体下意识后退，奈何速度太快没站稳，整个人往后倒。

萧临戍手臂比脑子快，直接揽住她的腰肢，手臂一紧。

整个人如蹁跹的蝴蝶跌进了他的怀里，紧紧靠在一起。

柔软，细腻，单薄，整个人像团温软的云。

害怕云飘走，他稍微用了些力气。

“疼！”

季望棉倒吸一口冷气。

这不是装的，萧临戍的胸膛太硬了，胸口硌得慌！

萧临戍跟她的感觉完全相反，他想再用力更用力，将她整个揉进身体里。

原来女人的身体是这么软，这么香，他好想咬一口。

季望棉推了推他，萧临戍才依依不舍的放开。

“对不起，我不是故意的！”

季望棉隐晦的搓了搓胸口，摇头表示没事。

她再隐晦，萧临戍还是看的一清二楚，身体快速的向后转，把刚才的一幕扔出脑子。

偏偏，刚才每一分波动他都记得清清楚楚。

领口揉搓的时候敞开了不少，半圆的白面团子在脑中不停地晃荡。

他唾弃自己现在像个流氓，心底的喜悦又有些压不住。

季望舒觉得舒服了一些，才柔声开口：“萧大哥～你找我有事吗？不好意思，我今天走路太多，一不小心睡着了。”

“没事，”萧临戍声音沉沉的，“我已经做好饭了，吃完饭我烧点水，你洗个热水澡睡一觉更舒服。”

“谢谢你，萧大哥～”

“没关系，那个，你先去吃，我，我现在不饿！”

头也没回快步回了自己的房间。

季望舒有些奇怪，在对方关门的一刹那明白了。

脸颊通的一下红了。

短视频刷多了，她下意识往鲛珠的地方看。

上辈子她最多是喊男模来过过摸巧克力的手瘾，其他的倒是没有过。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The military service club is equivalent to a small store and daily supply station within the army, and outsiders cannot enter.

Things inside are cheaper than those at supply and marketing cooperatives outside, and things like flashlights and batteries require specific tickets outside, but you can buy them casually here.

Of course, if you want to buy some scarce goods, you can also buy them here, which is a benefit for military personnel.

But how could she get this job!

Just when Ji Wangmian was struggling, there were footsteps at the door. Ji Wangmian smiled evilly and stood up.

When I opened the door and walked out, I was met with a warm and moist embrace.

"Ouch!"

Ji Wangmian retreated subconsciously, but the speed was too fast and he couldn't stand still, so he fell backwards.

Xiao Linshu's arms were faster than his brain, and he directly wrapped his arms around her waist and tightened his arms.

The whole body fell into his arms like a fluttering butterfly and leaned closely together.

Soft, delicate, and thin, the whole figure is like a warm cloud.

Afraid that the clouds would drift away, he used a little more strength.

"It hurts!"

Ji Wangmian took a breath of air.

This is not pretending, Xiao Linshu's chest is too hard, and his chest is so tight!

Xiao Linshu felt completely opposite to hers. He wanted to use more force to rub her into his body.

It turned out that a woman's body was so soft and fragrant, and he really wanted to take a bite.

Ji Wangmian pushed him, and Xiao Linshu reluctantly let go.

"I'm sorry, I didn't mean it!"

Ji Wangmian rubbed his chest vaguely and shook his head to indicate that it was okay.

No matter how cryptic she was, Xiao Linshu could still see it clearly. He quickly turned back and threw the scene out of his mind.

However, he clearly remembered every fluctuation just now.

The collar opened quite a bit when I kneaded it, and the semicircle of white dough kept swaying in my mind.

He despised himself for looking like a gangster now, and the joy in his heart couldn't be suppressed.

Ji Wangshu felt a little more comfortable and then spoke softly: "Brother Xiao, do you have a problem with me? I'm sorry, I walked too much today and accidentally fell asleep."

"It's okay," Xiao Linshu said in a deep voice, "I've already prepared the meal. After dinner, I'll boil some water. It will be more comfortable for you to take a hot bath and sleep."

"Thank you, Brother Xiao~"

"It doesn't matter, um, you go eat first, I, I'm not hungry now!"

He hurried back to his room without looking back.

Ji Wangshu was a little strange, but he understood the moment the other party closed the door.

His cheeks turned red.

After watching too many short videos, she subconsciously looked towards Shark Pearl.

In her previous life, she had only experienced the addiction of touching chocolate by calling male models, but she had never experienced anything else.
